notes.title: Full Game Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/d01d3830acba925c4fa0421e68d0607391a1cb18.jpg[/img]

Heya,

The day has come: SuchArt is now fully and officially out. Thank you so much for supporting us all the way through the Early Access – the game wouldn’t reach its current state without your feedback, as well as there would be no community without you actively participating in the life of the [url=https://discord.gg/T4jZyTQ]SuchArt discord server[/url] and painting your masterpieces. So yeah, your contribution cannot be overestimated, and we truly appreciate it.

[previewyoutube=0F_GxnR9I28;full][/previewyoutube]

Since today is a big day indeed, you can grab SuchArt with a 20% launch discount. Moreover, you can get an additional 15% off if you purchase it as a part of our bundle with House Flipper – quite a bargain, isn’t it?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

Don’t forget that we’re also running a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1293180/view/3556180117860357344]contest[/url] in which you can win SuchArt Steam key and help us spread the word about the game at the same time – make sure to check it out!

But let’s move to the most interesting part – the new stuff we promised to tell you about (spoiler: no worries, your saves should remain safe and sound!).

[h3]Hangar[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/99a832af302d3ab2303eb59c9c1179a82fdd6b6c.png[/img]

The hangar is a new spacious area distinct from your studio. A new space with its own game mechanics, items, characters and commissions. It brings larger and more complex items to paint in game, and aims to bring more variety to the mid and late game.

=> It is unlocked shortly after reaching the 4th level of fame. You will get an email from a new character. If you load a save past this level of fame, you should quickly receive the email as well. It is also always available in Creative mode.

[h3]Gallery rework[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/7b35cd967d34391eccbe2e53bca214d65dfae188.png[/img]

The gallery has been reworked and expanded. It is now much bigger, and has a new area with its distinct atmosphere and display mechanics.

[h3]The Virtualizer[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/0502df36cd70226460844b7fa6e2052c65232e8f.png[/img]

The virtualizer is a new tool which you can use to get a copy, in your gallery, of furniture and other decorative items that you possess in your studio. For a small fee.

It is available in the shop, in the “workshop” tab.

[h3]The Omni Shield[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/879b696d7de9ece040384454903501437f3865a7.png[/img]

The Omni Shield is a new tool. Its advanced technology allows you to protect any surface of your choice from being painted. Blow up those spray cans safely!

It is available in the shop, in the “workshop” tab.

[h3]Other changes and additions[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/d489194f5840b04c3b3e8a7e960f4f93a36448a6.png[/img]

- The studio has been reworked to offer more space in the main area
- The corridor and elevator can now be accessed again after the introduction
- Unique items from the Story mode are now also available in the Creative mode, from the shop
- Shop: shorter and universal delivery times, replaced delivery timer with a progress bar
- Added step ladders in the shop
- Added 5 new pieces of furniture in the shop
- Lowered the price of many furniture items
- Re-organized the shop categories
- Updated lacquer sprays and added multiple cap variants (now similar to the regular spray cans)
- Faster running speed
- Various optimizations
- Cleaner canvases models

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

- Tablet support has been improved and should work properly with more devices / setups
- Fixed partially broken Journal UI for some screen resolutions
- Fixed some game credit entries
- Fixed some obscure PetBot issues
- Range of minor / other fixes

[h3]Saves compatibility[/h3]

Your old saves should be compatible with the update, with a few quirks:
- Some items may be relocated during the update
- A few walls and floors in the studio (main room, downstairs) have been remodelled for the studio enlargement. Anything you have painted there (walls, floor, ceiling, window, etc) will likely be altered with the update.


If you come across any issues or bugs, please report them either on our Discord server or in the comment below this post, cheers.

We hope you have a fantastic artistic journey – bon voyage!

notes.title: Full Release & Biggest Update on Oct 13!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/3576b3ce67065fbc1144c13c731b8ab114672c6c.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

SuchArt has been in Early Access for a year and a few months, and this period has been indeed fruitful: the game has 97% positive reviews, over 200k wishlists, and almost 800k players taking Creative Space into account – a great amount of work has been put into SuchArt, and we see that you guys appreciate it.

As much as we’d like to keep the intrigue, the title already gave it away – yes, the big moment has arrived, and [b]SuchArt finally leaves Early Access on October 13, 10 AM PT[/b]. Moreover, it also gets its biggest update to yet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

The full release update will introduce a whole bunch of new content: reworked studio and gallery, a new Hangar area with its own game mechanics, new tools, items, commissions, and much, much more. We’ll tell you everything about the new stuff upon the release – it’s super exciting, take our word for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/a35180f9ab63bf751975da7f444ccc21fe2b9ae2.jpg[/img]

To celebrate an event of such magnitude, everyone will be able to grab the game with a 20% launch discount. Besides, SuchArt can be purchased as a part of our bundle with House flipper with an additional 15% off.

We hope you’re as excited about the upcoming full release as we are! If you’ve been following and (hopefully) enjoying SuchArt for a while now, you can help us spread the word about the game and share it with your friends or, say, your favourite influencer – this would be the greatest help possible!


Set a reminder for October 13, make sure you’ve got enough space on your computer, and get ready to conquer new artistic horizons – your most fascinating creative journey is yet ahead!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

notes.title: When is SuchArt coming out?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170404/c87ae3f8a5f9b3b518b200ebe35d630866031a99.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

We know that many of you have been waiting for SuchArt to be released for quite a while now — we get lots of questions about the release date/time every day, we see all of them, yet we can’t give a proper answer, which can possibly be quite disturbing for you. What we definitely don’t want is you being disturbed, that’s why we believe it’s the right time to share our release plans and explain why we’re not giving any specific dates just yet.

First of all, we’d like to reassure you a bit: the game itself is stable — all the core features are ready, and we’re now mainly adding new languages and fixing some minor bugs. Thanks to our awesome Discord community we managed to select people who’ve been helping us with the game testing over the past months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/1f10b268d1aa250c907cac3d8cf0cb889c2ad439.gif[/img]
[i]Please be kind to your PetBot![/i]

There’ll be a lot of stuff awaiting you upon release: a complete story campaign, a separate Creative Mode, a lovely robot assistant PetBot, and many other features related to painting and customizing your studio. Despite all this, SuchArt is likely to be released as an Early Access game. Not because it’s not finished, but because we’re planning to continue adding new features and opportunities to the game based on your future feedback, and Early Access seems to be the best option for such continuous improvements. 

In order for the game to be successful, we need to pick the best release date possible, so it’s one of the most crucial tasks for us at the moment. Release on a bad day can be critical for a small project like ours — there’s always a chance of getting lost among other releases and not getting enough attention and sales at the start (and the first days after the release are actually the most important ones). May and June happened to be extremely replete with releases and other gaming-related events: that’s why we have already postponed SuchArt release several times.

We’ve got a date in mind which we’re now aiming for (don’t worry, it’s in the foreseeable future), and we intend to announce it two weeks before the due date, [b]when we’re 100% sure it won’t change[/b]. We really hope you understand and share our concerns and caution. 

Anyway, thank you so much for looking forward to the full version of SuchArt — it’ll be out pretty soon, just wait a tiny bit more. And you’ll love it, promise! 


[h2]Wishlist SuchArt in order not to miss it:
[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

And, of course, have a beautiful day! <3

notes.title: Update 1.2.15.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The full game is around the corner, yet we continue to polish Creative Space for you as well, because it's this version you're playing now, and, I mean, why not. 

So, what's new:


Additions and changes
[list]
[*] Added Japanese
[*] Added 10 more save slots
[*] Added VSync option to the LimitFPS game option
[*] Hightech easel now has a button to reset rotations
[*] Minor rendering improvements for some brushes’ head
[*] Adjusted cursor speed in menus
[*] Adjusted movement and rotation forces of the objects being grabbed and moved by the player
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Much less buggy bobblehead physics
[*] Fixed stencils could prevent paint from drying, even after being detached
[*] Fixed some tools FXs (such as the smoke after using the blowtorch) would suddenly disappear if the player switched for another tool
[*] Snapping objects (such as a canvas on an easel) should now be better at finding the closest angle
[*] Player now always properly recovered if glitched out of the studio
[*] Fixed the head of the standard brush could sometimes become invisible
[*] Fixed couldn’t use a gamepad in the main menu (after game launch) without having at least one mouse click first
[*] Fixed stencils clipping when overlapping
[*] Fixed could send 2 paintings for the same commission by using both terminals at the same time 
[*] Fixed using the simple 'Save' button would unpause the game while still having the menu overlay opened
[/list]


That's it — hope you enjoy the updated experience and have a lovely day :3

Oh, and make sure full version of SuchArt is in your wishlist on Steam so you don't miss the release - it's coming soon!

notes.title: Update 1.0.9.2 — new tools, fixes and more!
notes.content:
Hey there,

As you all know, it’s been almost a month since the release of Creative Space. So, do you know what time it is? Right, it’s time for an update! A relatively big one on top of that.

First of all, we’ve unlocked [b]3 more items from the full game[/b]:

- A small painting knife
- Slices of wood (can be decorative or used as a canvas)
- A color-shifter tool

Now you’ve got even more stuff to toy around with and create your dream art, yay! But wait a bit, that’s not it just yet — here a few other changes:

- Players now start the game with a bit of pocket money (100C)
- Money rewards for commissions are slightly increased
- Selling time on the marketplace has been lowered
- Fixed in-game time would go slower if the game had low FPS (which means faster emails answers, deliveries, and marketplace sells for players being below 60FPS)

Okay, now that’s it. Cool, right? Sounds like a perfect occasion to dig into the game again (to try all the new tools and spend your precious pocket money at least). 


Traditionally, here are some amazing paintings made by our amazing players. Not a top 10, but still — let’s enjoy them together!

notes.title: Turkish localization, 80,000+ players and more!

First of all, Creative Space got an update with Turkish localization, yay! A community of Turkish players has been actively evolving on [url=discord.gg/4vTRcfS]our Discord[/url], so eventually we realized that we kinda had no choice but to do it (for you know that we always listen to your needs!), and this became just a matter of time, really. And yeah, here it is now, already available in the game — you’re very welcome to try it (especially if you know Turkish).

Also, here’s a couple of other fixes/improvements:

- Minor updates to the Russian localization
- Fixed some occlusion issues (parts of the studio becoming invisible if standing in some places)

And, last but not least, the number of Creative Space players has grown over 80k and started looking even more impressive. Well, the more the merrier, right? notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here is a small update, covering a range of fixes and minor changes.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed hanging an object on a split door could prevent the said door from closing
[*]Fixed the emails' accepting-a-commission button not being interactable anymore after the player was getting told about already having too many ongoing commissions (ie: hard-to-phrase minor bug fix)
[*]Fixed some bits of the delivery room not being paintable
[*]Fixed the music ball's inventory preview not updating properly
[*]Fixed some occlusion issues (ie parts of the studio disappearing if standing in some specific locations)
[*]Reduced spray fumes particles effect from bright sprays, and reduced clipping from the effect
[*]Fixed buckets would sometimes slowly but surely fly away when the game was paused
[*]Fixed drying a wet metallic surface with the hairdryer would make the surface more reflective instead of actually drying it
[*]Fixed fast clicking several times to sell a painting could cause the terminal to bug
[*]Fixed buckets were kindly being delivered full of water
[*]Fixed walking on an area freshly painted and cleaned would still produce paint steps despite having been cleaned
[*]Applying fresh paint on top of dry paint should now mix less than before (this was especially noticeable with painting knife and with brushes low on paint)
[*]More stable buckets (reduced jitter, especially when full of items)
[/list]

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Better bobblehead and wooden easel colliders
[*]Better blowtorch smoke effect and surface burning
[*]Changed the rotation icon for the painting knife tool
[*]Added a minimum required distance to be able to spill the content of a bucket (when being in hand)
[*]Added an option to limit the FPS of the game. It seems though to cause some jitter, at least from what I have tested, I am not sure if this will be the case for everyone who tries to use it. So let's say this is still an experimental feature!
[/list]

That's it! Please reach out (preferably on our discord server) if you experience any bug, and happy painting!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an occlusion issue (the studio becoming invisible) if standing in some places near the space window
[*] Fixed lighting of the empty room's door
[*] Better blowtorch alpha painting behavior (ie targeting a screen with the blowtorch)
[*] Fixed missing Chinese characters
[/list]

Happy painting!
